description: Figure 8 illustrates the performance of different inference methods—DeepSpeed, H₂O, and Pyramidal—on LLaMA 2 models with 13B and 70B parameters, displaying KV memory usage and throughput. The x-axis represents length, labeled as “Length,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 512+256 for the 13B model and 0 to 256+128 for the 70B model, in units of tokens. The y-axis represents KV memory usage, labeled as “KV Mem.,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5, in units of GB. For the 13B model, the DeepSpeed method is represented by a blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 2.3 GB at a length of 0 tokens and increasing to approximately 3.5 GB at a length of 512+256 tokens. The H₂O method is shown as a green line with square markers, beginning at approximately 2.2 GB at a length of 0 tokens and rising to approximately 3.4 GB at a length of 512+256 tokens. The Pyramidal method is depicted by a red dashed line with diamond markers, starting at approximately 11.0 GB at a length of 0 tokens and decreasing to approximately 1.4 GB at a length of 512+256 tokens. For the 70B model, DeepSpeed is a blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 4.2 GB at a length of 0 tokens and increasing to approximately 4.4 GB at a length of 256+128 tokens. H₂O is a green line with square markers, beginning at approximately 4.2 GB at a length of 0 tokens and remaining at approximately 4.2 GB at a length of 256+128 tokens. Pyramidal is a red dashed line with diamond markers, starting at approximately 4.2 GB at a length of 0 tokens and decreasing to approximately 2.0 GB at a length of 256+128 tokens.
